implementationDetails.audioStrategy: One AudioContext and one output node. A TypeScript DSP kernel (src/audio/dsp/stage.ts) runs in an AudioWorklet, or in a ScriptProcessorNode when the worklet is unavailable. Grand, Upright, and Electric play bundled recordings (198 FLAC files, 12 MB, decoded by the app's own FLAC decoder). Clav, Digital, and Misc are live additive synthesis and are labelled as synthesis in the model name, on the Program display, and in the status console. If a sample set cannot be loaded, its layer plays a synthesized stand-in voice labelled "Fallback Synth Piano", the type LED flashes, and the audio status reads Fallback, never Ready. The Organ (six models) and the Synth (fourteen waveforms) are live synthesis: nothing in them is a recording, and nothing is described as one. The only stored audio in the whole instrument is the three piano sample sets. The organ reads band-limited single-cycle wavetables that it computes in memory from fixed harmonic recipes when a kernel starts; they are generated buffers, declared below, and are not recordings. All effects are computed live in the kernel; no impulse responses or other audio buffers are bundled.
